## Before you install

Coming from an older copy: uninstall it first. Android will not install this over it, and stops
with `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE`. Uninstalling clears game statistics and settings. It
does not touch the Chess app the phone came with; Chess+ installs alongside it.

Already on v1.3.3 or later: this installs over it and keeps everything.
